title: Allow --reroute once implementation has begun

escalations.reason:

  FIX: add ## Amendment Round 2 to tasks/reroute-from-implement/spec.md, then: canon run reroute-from-implement --reroute
  BLESS: canon task accept reroute-from-implement code_review --reason "<why>"
